title: GitHub Actions schedule for the two unscheduled lead-finder crons (on by default, loud no-op without the secret)
interface: Workflow `name: lead-finder-cron`, `on: { schedule: [{ cron: '*/5 * * * *' }], workflow_dispatch: {} }`, `permissions: {}`, `concurrency: { group: lead-finder-cron, cancel-in-progress: false }`, one job `ping` on ubuntu-latest, `timeout-minutes: 7`, `env: { CRON_SECRET: ${{ secrets.CRON_SECRET }} }`, steps: (1) `if [ -z "$CRON_SECRET" ]; then echo '::warning::CRON_SECRET repository secret is not set; skipping'; echo 'skip=true' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; fi` with `id: check`; (2) `if: steps.check.outputs.skip != 'true'` -> `curl -fsS --max-time 65 -H "Authorization: Bearer $CRON_SECRET" https://pulse-crm-weld.vercel.app/api/cron/lead-finder-worker` (worker maxDuration is 60 in vercel.json); (3) same guard -> `curl -fsS --max-time 295 -H "Authorization: Bearer $CRON_SECRET" https://pulse-crm-weld.vercel.app/api/cron/lead-finder` (route maxDuration 300); steps 2 and 3 `continue-on-error: true`. Header comment: Hobby plan allows only the two daily crons in vercel.json; the repo is public so Actions minutes are free; GitHub's minimum interval is 5 minutes and schedules may be delayed or disabled after 60 days without repo activity; the owner adds CRON_SECRET (same value as the Vercel env var). vercel.json is NOT edited. RULING (merge): steps 2 and 3 get ids `worker` and `scheduler`; a final step `Fail if any request failed` with `if: steps.check.outputs.skip != 'true' && (steps.worker.outcome == 'failure' || steps.scheduler.outcome == 'failure')` runs `echo '::error::a cron request failed' && exit 1`, so the run is red whenever a request failed while both routes were still attempted.
